bagPolicy.summary: Berlin hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: Porzana, the restaurant next door, shares its paid valet service with Berlin guests.
parking.quote: Our next-door neighbors at Porzana are happy to share their paid valet services

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Berlin. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Berlin has a one-item minimum for each guest. The menu is posted on Berlin's website.
concessions.quote: We have a one-item minimum for each patron.

accessibility.summary: Berlin hasn't published accessibility details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

reEntry.summary: Berlin hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Reservations aren't needed or accepted, and Berlin can sometimes release a few tickets at the door on the day of the show. Gift cards can't be used for advance tickets online, and anyone under 18 must be with an adult.
ticketPickup.quote: We can sometimes release a few tickets at the door on the day of the show.

gates.summary: The time listed for each show is when the music starts. Seating is first come, first served, and only complete parties can be seated, so arrive early.
gates.quote: Come early, as seating is first come, first served.
